description.value: AnnaLena is a Michelin-starred tasting menu restaurant in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, steps from Kitsilano Beach, owned since 2015 by Chef Michael Robbins and General Manager Jeff Parr. Consistently ranked among Canada's Top 100 Restaurants and an En Route Top 10 New Restaurant in its opening year, it offers an exclusively reservation-based, multi-course tasting menu driven by seasonal local farms and suppliers. The restaurant pairs its evolving menu with an award-winning wine program curated by Michelin-recognised Wine Director Reverie Beall.
